title: From OOP to a Flat Vtable: Rethinking the RHI in a Single-File Architecture
description: How an OOP class hierarchy spread across a dozen files became impossible to extend, and why collapsing it into a single flat vtable dispatch model made adding an entirely new graphics API (WebGPU) mechanical rather than architectural.

title: GPU In-Flight Hazards: Why Resize Crashes and How to Fix It
description: How a window resize event caused intermittent GPU crashes in Usul's editor, why the per-frame fence isn't enough to protect shared resources, and why vkDeviceWaitIdle is the correct tool for resource reallocation.

title: Descriptor Set Invalidation in Vulkan: The Hidden Rule About Mid-Loop Writes
description: A deep dive into the Vulkan validation error that fires when you call vkUpdateDescriptorSets on a descriptor set that's still bound in a recording command buffer—and the three correct ways to fix it.

title: The Flipped-Y Problem: Why ImGuizmo Moves Entities the Wrong Way
description: How Vulkan's negative-height viewport trick, ImGui UV compensation, and ImGuizmo's screen-space math all interact to invert gizmo Y-axis behavior—and the one-line projection matrix fix.

title: Wayland Architecture from First Principles: A Deconstruction of the Modern Linux Display Server
description: An in-depth look at the first principles of Wayland's design, deconstructing how it eliminates architectural overhead to achieve its core design promise: 'Every frame is perfect.'
